description: High-end, industrial-grade Cold Chain Tracker Dashboard built with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS. Features realistic telemetry charts and shipment tracking.
longDescription: A robust, high-performance web dashboard engineered for logistics and supply chain management. This application visualizes real-time telemetry data, providing intuitive insights into temperature fluctuations and shipment statuses across the cold chain.
features: Responsive and premium industrial UI design

description: A cinematic, responsive wedding invitation website featuring micro-animations, calligraphy text reveals, and glowing UI elements.
longDescription: An ethereal and cinematic digital wedding invitation designed to provide a premium user experience. Built with Svelte and GSAP, it features intricate scroll-triggered animations, glowing visual effects, and seamless transitions to create a memorable impression.
features: Responsive layout optimized for all devices

description: An automated, IoT-enabled DIY fish feeder designed for sleek aquariums. Features precise feeding controls and a modern aesthetic.
longDescription: A complete IoT hardware and software solution for automated aquarium maintenance. This DIY fish feeder integrates microcontrollers with a custom web interface, allowing users to schedule feedings with precision while maintaining a sleek, modern look for their tank setup.

description: A modern, sleek, and cinematic IPTV application user interface dashboard displaying live channels and futuristic streaming layouts.
longDescription: A next-generation user interface for IPTV streaming, conceptualized to mimic the premium feel of top-tier streaming services. The dashboard features dynamic channel browsing, live preview capabilities, and a highly polished dark-mode aesthetic for immersive viewing.
features: Live channel browsing and EPG layouts
